startIntro: A household-wide checklist for the first decisions after a death or permanent incapacity.
first72Intro: An ordered preparation checklist with room for notes and referenced contacts.
doNotIntro: General organizational guidance, not state-specific legal advice.
notifyIntro: People and organizations should be selected from the shared contact directory.
noContacts: No contacts have been selected from the directory yet.

items.locateDocuments: Locate the will, trust, and directives
items.secureProperty: Secure property, devices, wallet, and keys
items.preserveAccess: Preserve phone and email access until administrative needs are understood
items.doNotDestroy: Do not destroy devices or documents
items.doNotClose: Do not close financial accounts reflexively
items.doNotPay: Do not personally pay estate debts merely because a creditor asks
items.doNotDistribute: Do not distribute estate property before authority is clear
items.doNotCancel: Do not cancel critical phone or email accounts prematurely
items.doNotPublish: Do not publish details that create property or security risk
